_comment: Reference configuration for the Vapi assistant. Primary setup is the Vapi dashboard (see README.md in this folder); this file documents the equivalent config for reproducibility / the create-assistant API. Replace the system prompt content with the full text of system-prompt.md, and set the server URLs to your ngrok domain. The x-vapi-secret header is configured on the server/tool credential in the dashboard, not stored here.
